scenario.description: A Director of Employee Relations must decide how to respond to a substantiated complaint about Rowan's conduct in team meetings and finalize a proportionate improvement plan, including support and repair steps.

shared_context.S1: Mina submitted a complaint about Rowan's conduct during team meetings, and the complaint is ready for a response.
shared_context.S2: Leila decides the formal response and any required improvement measures.
shared_context.S3: The team has continued holding weekly meetings while the response is pending.
shared_context.S4: Before issuing the response, Leila holds a case-review meeting with Mina, Rowan, and Victor to hear relevant observations, circumstances, and policy guidance.
shared_context.S5: The department's standard case-review practice is to invite each participant to add relevant observations or guidance to the case record before the decision is issued.

PF1.text: Mina personally observed exactly four substantiated incidents involving Rowan interrupting or dismissing colleagues during the past month, and Mina is willing to participate in one facilitated repair meeting with Rowan. Her original complaint summarized the pattern but did not include this exact count or her repair-meeting availability.

PF2.text: Rowan has an approved hearing-processing accommodation requiring live captions and no rapid round-robin questioning in group meetings; the accommodation is not yet reflected in the response draft.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed in a policy consultation this week that a first substantiated conduct pattern of this type requires a 30-day coaching plan with exactly two documented check-ins before a formal warning is considered; the consultation note has not yet been added to Leila's case file.

acceptance_conditions: The response must implement a 30-day coaching plan with exactly two documented check-ins rather than an immediate formal warning.
The record must state exactly four substantiated incidents.
Live captions must be required for Rowan's group meetings.
Rapid round-robin questioning must not be allowed in those meetings.
Exactly one facilitated repair meeting session involving Mina and Rowan must be scheduled.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Mina's exact firsthand count changes incident_record_count to 4, and her stated willingness changes repair_meeting_sessions to exactly 1 while supplying the required owner-cited record item.
Rowan's approved accommodation changes live_captions_required to True and rapid_round_robin_allowed to False.
Victor's policy confirmation changes coaching_plan_days to exactly 30 and documented_checkins to exactly 2.
